onboarding.headline: Where should your knowledge live?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick one to start. Arlo works the same way in both.
onboarding.personalDescription: Keep your notes and documents in a local folder. Everything stays on your machine, searchable instantly.
onboarding.teamDescription: Connect to a GitHub repository so your whole team shares and contributes to a single source of truth.
onboarding.footerNote: You can add more knowledge bases later.

settings.title: Settings

fields.nothingExcluded: Nothing excluded — every file is searched.

startup.label: On launch
startup.restoreAll: Reopen my last knowledge base and its drafts
startup.restoreAllHint: Drafts whose worktree no longer exists on disk are dropped silently.
startup.restoreKbHint: Drafts stay closed until you open them.
startup.startScreenHint: Choose a knowledge base each time.

autoCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
autoCheck.hint: Arlo Doc asks GitHub Releases whether a newer build exists.
autoCheck.pending: Saved — automatic updates are not switched on in this build

autoInstall.label: Download and install in the background
autoInstall.hint: Updates apply the next time you quit.

privacy.p1: Arlo Doc collects no analytics and reports no crashes. There is no Arlo server.
privacy.p2: It reaches the network in exactly two cases:
privacy.li2: — for updates, and for pushes you ask for
privacy.p3: Your documents never leave this machine except through git remotes you configured yourself.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Menus, buttons and messages. Independent of what the agent writes. Changes apply immediately.

autosave.label: Save automatically
autosave.hint: ⌘S saves immediately either way. Every version stays recoverable from git.

font.label: Editor font
font.hint: Leave empty to use the platform monospace stack.

lineNumbers.label: Show line numbers
lineNumbers.hintWrapping: Unavailable while long lines wrap — a gutter cannot line up with wrapped text.

model.mostCapableHint: Best for long documents and multi-file edits.
model.pending: Saved — the agent is not connected in this build
model.billed: Billed to your own Anthropic account.

autonomy.label: Agent autonomy
autonomy.reviewEachHint: Every edit waits for your approval.
autonomy.draftFreely: Apply in the draft, review before publishing
autonomy.draftFreelyHint: Edits land in the worktree; the pull request is the gate.
autonomy.alwaysConfirmed: Always confirmed, at every level: deleting a file · pushing to a remote.

connections.label: Connections
connections.blurb: Credentials live in your operating system keychain. Arlo Doc stores only ciphertext.

anthropic.encryptionOff: This system does not offer encrypted storage, so Arlo Doc will not save your key — it would have to be written in plain text. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment instead.
anthropic.storedNote: Stored in your operating system keychain. Arlo Doc sends it nowhere except api.anthropic.com, and the key is never shown to the app's interface again once saved.

github.notConnected: Not connected. Publishing a draft will ask you to sign in.

keyboard.label: Keyboard
keyboard.blurb: A reference, not a remapper — these are fixed for now.

about.label: About
about.encryptionUnavailable: This system offers no encrypted storage, so credentials cannot be saved.

reset.resetPreferencesDetail: Restores every default, for this and every knowledge base. Keeps your credentials, your repositories and your documents.
reset.forgetDetail: Removes the Anthropic API key and the GitHub token from your keychain. Nothing on disk is deleted and no repository is touched.

branch.noSpaces: Not a valid branch name — spaces aren't allowed.
branch.noDotDash: Cannot start or end with a dot or dash.
branch.illegalChars: Contains characters git does not allow.

repoPath.hint: Settings on this page apply only to this repository.

defaultBranch.label: Default branch
defaultBranch.hint: The branch new drafts fork from.

identity.fromGitConfig: From your git config — repository-local first, then global.
identity.noGitConfig: git has no user.name or user.email configured for this repository.
identity.name: Name
identity.overrideNote: Commits made here will use this identity instead of what git resolves.

markAgentCommits.label: Mark commits the agent wrote
markAgentCommits.hint: You remain the author — you approved the change.

openAsDraft.label: Open as a draft pull request

prTemplate.hint: {{summary}} and {{files}} are replaced when the pull request is drafted.
